action_summary: Removes the last handed-in object: the vocabulary. A reading is a tuple of (identity, content) rows sampled after every step; a goal is a function of some statistic of it. Four rungs of supplied structure are enumerated over the same reading on three real machines and five goals, and for each the coarsest sufficient statistic is computed and every cheaper one is refuted with a witness pair. The price of a goal in experiences falls 68 -> 55 -> 19 -> 5 (FILESYSTEM), 48 -> 7 -> 7 -> 4 (SQLITE), 32 -> 7 -> 7 -> 3 (TARBALL), 68 -> 56 -> 24 -> 6 (the 'moved, not copied' goal); every cell of every top table is pure; one statistic carries the same sentence on all three machines; the portable goal's statistic is provably blind to the pair goal and vice versa. A goal about which atom ran is outside every rung (0 of 3444 projections) because two sequences read identically and are judged oppositely, and the executor's own call log repairs it at 30 cells. Declared F4 (at most four cells at the top rung) NOT MET at five, and F5 (the statistic chosen on two-action runs survives three-action runs) NOT MET at 208 colliding pairs: sufficiency is reachability-relative. 23.7 s, 0 parameters, 0 model calls.
